name: us-local-income-tax-matrix
description: City and county income and wage taxes in the United States for 2026: Ohio municipal income tax under Revised Code 718.04, Pennsylvania local earned income tax under the Department of Community and Economic Development rules, Kentucky occupational license taxes in Lexington and Louisville, Michigan city income taxes with the 2026 Detroit rates, the St. Louis and Kansas City earnings taxes, Maryland county income tax rates for 2026, Indiana county withholding rates, the New York City and Yonkers pointer, and the Portland Metro supportive housing tax and the Multnomah County preschool tax. Each row uses the locality's or the state's own page. Pennsylvania return mechanics stay in pa-local-eit.
